title: Session detail -- Run
description: One running session, selected by clicking a row of a sessions table. The link passes the session's own time window, so the time picker starts exactly on the activity and stays usable to zoom in. Panels are keyed on $activity_id AND the time range.

list.name: activity_id
list.query: SELECT aw.activity_id AS __value, to_char(aw.start_time_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  ' || coalesce(aw.name, aw.sport) AS __text FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = aw.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' ORDER BY aw.local_date DESC LIMIT 200
list.definition: SELECT aw.activity_id AS __value, to_char(aw.start_time_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '  ' || coalesce(aw.name, aw.sport) AS __text FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = aw.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' ORDER BY aw.local_date DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Session
panels.description: Identity and totals from mart.activity_wide: date, sport, name, data quality, duration and distance. data_quality = unknown means summary-only import with no streams, so every sample panel below will be empty.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(aw.local_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date", aw.sport AS "Sport", aw.name AS "Name", aw.data_quality AS "Data quality", aw.duration_s / 3600.0 AS "Duration", aw.distance_m / 1000.0 AS "Distance", aw.ascent_m AS "Ascent" FROM mart.activity_wide aw WHERE aw.activity_id = $activity_id

panels.title: Load & derived
panels.description: Training load and derived metrics from mart.activity_wide. The _method columns stay visible on purpose: a TSS from HR and a TSS from power do not carry the same information.

targets.rawSql: SELECT aw.tss AS "TSS", aw.tss_method AS "TSS method", aw.intensity_factor AS "IF", aw.efficiency_factor AS "EF", aw.decoupling_pct AS "Decoupling (%)", aw.trimp AS "TRIMP" FROM mart.activity_wide aw WHERE aw.activity_id = $activity_id

panels.title: Physiology & power
panels.description: Session averages and peaks from mart.activity_wide. avg_power is Garmin Running Power -- a DIFFERENT scale from bike sensor power, never to be compared across disciplines.

targets.rawSql: SELECT aw.avg_hr AS "Avg HR", aw.max_hr AS "Max HR", aw.avg_power AS "Avg power" FROM mart.activity_wide aw WHERE aw.activity_id = $activity_id

panels.title: Running dynamics
panels.description: Averages of the per-second running dynamics in core.sample. Empty when the run was recorded without the running dynamics source (no optical HRM strap or older device profile).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(s.cadence)::numeric, 0) AS "Cadence", round(avg(s.vertical_oscillation)::numeric, 1) AS "Vert. osc. (cm)", round(avg(s.stance_time)::numeric, 0) AS "Stance (ms)", round(avg(s.step_length)::numeric, 2) AS "Step (m)" FROM core.sample s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id

panels.title: Heart rate
panels.description: Per-second heart rate from core.sample for the selected activity. Empty for summary-only imports.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.t AS time, s.heart_rate AS "HR (bpm)" FROM core.sample s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id AND s.heart_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Power (Garmin Running Power)
panels.description: Per-second running power from core.sample, watts, for the selected activity. Not comparable with bike power: do not read this panel against cycling thresholds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.t AS time, s.power AS "Power (W)" FROM core.sample s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id AND s.power IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pace & altitude
panels.description: Pace (min/km, from per-second speed; samples under 0.5 m/s excluded -- auto-pause spikes) and altitude relative to the leg start (GPS-only altitude drifts with no barometer: the ramp is drift, not terrain).

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.t AS time, 1000.0 / NULLIF(s.speed_mps, 0) AS "Pace (min/km)" FROM core.sample s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id AND s.speed_mps > 0.5 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.t AS time, round((s.altitude_m - min(s.altitude_m) OVER ())::numeric, 1) AS "Altitude (m, relative)" FROM core.sample s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id AND s.altitude_m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cadence & step length
panels.description: Per-second cadence and step length from core.sample for the selected activity. Cadence as recorded by the watch; step length in metres on the right axis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.t AS time, s.cadence AS "Cadence" FROM core.sample s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id AND s.cadence IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
SELECT s.t AS time, s.step_length AS "Step length (m)" FROM core.sample s WHERE s.activity_id = $activity_id AND s.step_length IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time in HR zones
panels.description: Seconds per HR zone, bounds in PERCENT OF MAX HR as requested: Z1 <60%, Z2 60-70%, Z3 70-80%, Z4 80-90%, Z5 >=90%. Max HR comes from core.threshold (discipline 'all', valid at the session date) and falls back to the session's own recorded max HR when no threshold row exists. Note: hrTSS itself stays computed on %LTHR (Friel zones); this panel is a display bucket only. Empty when the session carries no HR data.

targets.rawSql: WITH th AS (SELECT coalesce(t.hr_max_bpm, aw.max_hr) AS hrmax FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.hr_max_bpm FROM core.threshold t WHERE t.athlete_id = a.athlete_id AND t.discipline = 'all' AND t.validity @> a.local_date AND t.hr_max_bpm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) t ON true WHERE aw.activity_id = $activity_id), b AS (SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Z1 <60%' AS zone, 0.0::real AS lo, 0.60::real AS hi UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Z2 60-70%', 0.60, 0.70 UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Z3 70-80%', 0.70, 0.80 UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Z4 80-90%', 0.80, 0.90 UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Z5 >=90%', 0.90, 9.99) SELECT b.zone AS "Zone", coalesce(sum(h.seconds), 0) AS "Seconds" FROM b CROSS JOIN th LEFT JOIN core.activity_hr_histogram h ON h.activity_id = $activity_id AND h.hr_bpm >= (b.lo * th.hrmax) AND h.hr_bpm < (b.hi * th.hrmax) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.activity_hr_histogram x WHERE x.activity_id = $activity_id) GROUP BY b.ord, b.zone ORDER BY b.ord

panels.title: Laps
panels.description: core.activity_lap: the watch's own lap boundaries, i.e. the training intention. Empty when the session was recorded without laps.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.lap_index AS "Lap", to_char(l.start_time, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Start", l.duration_s / 60.0 AS "Duration (min)", l.distance_m / 1000.0 AS "Distance (km)", l.avg_hr AS "Avg HR", l.max_hr AS "Max HR", l.avg_power AS "Avg power (W)", l.ascent_m AS "Ascent (m)" FROM core.activity_lap l WHERE l.activity_id = $activity_id ORDER BY l.lap_index
